Electric blankets: choose the intended use and follow the care instructions

An underblanket is different from a heated throw

Check where the product is intended to sit, the bed size it fits and whether its instructions permit the use you have planned. Compare the heated area and control zones, not just the outer fabric dimensions. A timer or automatic shut-off does not establish overnight suitability for every blanket. Check compatibility with your mattress or adjustable bed rather than assuming all bedding arrangements are approved.

Inspect the product and its support route

Find the exact instructions for washing, drying, storage and controller connection. London Fire Brigade advises checking blankets for signs of damage and following their instructions. Read London Fire Brigade electric-blanket guidance. Check the model against official recall notices and stop using damaged equipment. A cheaper open-box offer needs a clear condition description and the correct controller; price is not a safety assessment.
